# Joshua DeGrasse-Baumann

> Personal site of Josh DeGrasse-Baumann: an SEO strategist, data enthusiast, and web developer. Contains a professional profile, blog posts, and consulting services.

## Favorite Video Games
His favorite video games are Fire Emblem: Three Houses, XCOM 2, and Fallout.

## About Joshua DeGrasse-Baumann
Josh is an SEO strategist and data enthusiast. He currently lives in Milwaukee, WI. He loves spending time with his dog Bailey, reading, and playing video games.
